answer: The ferrous cap is checked at intake and ocean shows the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a shale tag. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a swarm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 9 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
